_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Yin acë Wɛ̈t de {player_id} kɛ Threes-Player Tic Tac Toe.
Symbol yin aye '{symbol}'.
Yin rot lo̱i kɛmɛ̈th symbol yin kɛ board 5x5 kuɛ̈t thok ke kɛ̈ cɛ̈ thok.
Thok aye kɛ̈ thok, kɛ̈ thok, kɛ̈ thok ku kɛ̈ thok.
Jot ke kɛmɛ̈th '[4]' kɛmɛ̈th ke thok 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kɛmɛ̈th format thok. Lo '[cell]' kɛmɛ̈th ke bɛ̈n 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Thok cell number: {cell}. Kɔc bɛ̈n 0 na {max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Raan ye gɔ̈ɔ̈r {player_id} acï lɔ tueŋ ke cie luɔide.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} places their symbol ({symbol}) in field ({row}, {col}).

outcome.draw: Aköl ë yic ee kë ye kɔc thɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ!
